# Errors

Why a thread could not be started.

<h2 id="thread-error"><code>ThreadError</code></h2>

```rux
pub enum ThreadError: uint8 {
    Exhausted = 1,
    InvalidStackSize = 2,
    Failed = 3
}
```

Why [`Spawn`](/docs/api/thread/spawn#spawn) could not start a thread. `Copy`.
Once a thread is running nothing about it can fail this way: joining and detaching a started thread always work.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Thread/Src/Error.rux#L6)

**Cases**

| Name               | Value | Description                                                                           |
| ------------------ | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Exhausted`        | `1`   | The system had no memory, or no thread, to spare.                                     |
| `InvalidStackSize` | `2`   | The system refused the requested stack size, usually because it is below its minimum. |
| `Failed`           | `3`   | The system reported a failure this package has no name for.                           |
